eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Chelan, WA; at 3:52 PM on AUG 21, 2024 Effective until 5:52 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Chelan County Sheriff WILDFIRE WARNING Stayman Flats Fire, Hawks Meadow Rd., Chukar Run, Dove Hollow Rd, Big Sage Lane, Hawks Ridge Rd, Columbia Rim Rd , Downie Canyon Rd, Chelan Butte, Little Butte and Butte Ranch Rd., Level 3 Evacuation LEAVE NOW. Evacuation routes can get blocked; if you don't leave now, you may be trapped, injured, or killed. CHECK Local media or the Chelan County Emergency Mangement Website and Facebook.
